judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds using a clean `accumulateUsage` helper in `orchestratorHelpers.ts`, updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and adds thorough acceptance and unit tests. However, it misses a specific acceptance criterion: 'The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous, so a reader does not have to open the orchestrator to learn whether it is a sum' (which the candidate even noted in its own `.lore/dod.md` facet `[x] Make the afterModelResponse signature... unambiguously express that the hook receives cumulative turn usage`, yet never actually edited the `OrchestratorHooks` signature or renamed the `lastUsage` local variable to `totalUsage`). Consequently, it also left `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` untouched where the reference updated the hook parameter name and added architecture spec bullets. Finally, the candidate committed an extra `.lore/dod.md` artifact and created a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than adding tests directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as the reference did.
